User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Wicker application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user, matching Firebase Auth UID.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

senderUsername.description: The username of the user who sent the message.

recipientId.description: The UID of the user who will receive the message.

recipientUsername.description: The username of the user who will receive the message.

content.description: The encrypted content of the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

definition.description: Stores public user data, like username, for discoverability.

params.name: userId
params.description: The user's unique ID, same as their Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores all messages in a single root collection.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique ID for the message.
